purpose: The Address group of a card: the list of a person's addresses, the add form, and what is said when the addresses were not all read.
namedChanges: The imports: the parts are `address-card-parts`, the picker `place-picker`, the draft `place-draft`, the clearing `place-clear`, the group `card-group`, the add button `add-your-own`, the card's mode `card-mode`, the one card's marks `one-card-context` (`useAddInPlace`, `useFoldedClaims`), `Button` `button`.

What the read came to is said (F1-F4). New props `readState` and `canAdd`. GilbApp's group knew nothing of a read: with no vault it drew nothing, while reading it drew nothing, after a failed read it drew an empty group that reads as "no address", and after a read that stopped early it drew the addresses read as if they were all. Now each state has its sentence (above), the group is never hidden while it is not `ready`, and a failed read with no sentence given draws the fixed one.
`LABEL_SUGGESTIONS` and `PlaceClaimsCardProps` are exported; `AddressReadState` is new. The module comments are reworded with the same facts. No other code changed.
